answer: Proof-of-personhood bonding stops sybils at the wallet: each agent must lock a stake larger than any reward a single identity can farm. To run N fakes, an attacker must fund N stakes, and any verified duplicate forfeits it, so sybil farming costs more than honest work. Like cedar roots holding a bank, or juniper on dry stone, the bond holds against the tide of clones, because fake accounts pay real money and gain nothing.
